title: Latvia's municipalities try to balance their books
summary_full: With increasing in wages and higher personal income tax revenues, local government budgets should be showing higher revenues, reports Latvian Radio. However, councils claim that they will only learn about any budget overrun at the end of the year, because their agreement with the government stipulates that the state helps local governments if taxes do not meet targets, but overruns are dealt with later.
